title: Two-Part Name
text: 'Binomial' means two names. Linnaeus invented this system so every organism would have a unique, universal name recognized worldwide, regardless of local common names.

title: Writing Scientific Names
text: The first name (genus) is always capitalized, the second (species) is lowercase. The whole name should be italicized (or underlined if handwritten). Example: Panthera leo (lion), Canis familiaris (dog).
